title: Vertical Inline Pump

introduction.definition: A vertical inline pump has suction and discharge nozzles on the same centreline, so it can be installed directly in a pipeline like a valve. A single-stage impeller in a volute casing is driven by a vertical motor mounted on top, either close-coupled or through a rigid coupling (API 610 OH3/OH4/OH5).
applications: HVAC chilled and heating water circulation
Process transfer where floor space is limited
key_points: Motor removal on top for maintenance (back pull-out upward)

classification.api_610_type: OH3 (bearing bracket), OH4 (rigidly coupled), OH5 (close-coupled); model shows OH4-style rigid coupling

introduction.summary: A centrifugal pump designed to be installed directly in a straight pipe run: suction and discharge flanges face each other on one centreline. Liquid enters horizontally, turns upward into the eye of the vertical-shaft impeller, is discharged into the volute and turned back to the outlet flange. The vertical motor sits on a lantern above; a spacer coupling lets the seal be changed without disturbing the motor. Small footprint, common in HVAC, water and process plants.

parts.name: Closed Impeller

parts.name: Pump Shaft

parts.name: Vertical Motor – Rotor & Shaft

foundation: Pipe-supported pumps: supports either side carry the pipe; larger units stand on a pedestal foot.
alignment: Close-coupled units need no field alignment; rigid-coupled OH3 needs shaft run-out checks.
piping: Pipe supports close to both nozzles so the pump does not carry pipe weight beyond allowable loads.
Isolation valves both sides for removal.
commissioning: Fill and vent the casing; never run dry.
Check rotation direction with the coupling disconnected.
Start against a partly open discharge valve, then open to the duty point; avoid running at shut-off.
Record baseline vibration, bearing temperature, suction and discharge pressure, flow and motor current.

routine.task: Check seal leakage and motor bearing noise.

overhaul.task: Lift motor and rotating assembly; inspect impeller and seal.

causes: Air trapped at the seal chamber (vertical shaft)

video_tutorials.title: Vertical Inline Pump — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Vertical Inline Pump.
A vertical inline pump has suction and discharge nozzles on the same centreline, so it can be installed directly in a pipeline like a valve.
A single-stage impeller in a volute casing is driven by a vertical motor mounted on top, either close-coupled or through a rigid coupling (API 610 OH3/OH4/OH5).

Typical applications include HVAC chilled and heating water circulation; building services and pressure boosting; process transfer where floor space is limited; refinery and petrochemical services (OH3).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Inline Volute Casing, Closed Impeller, Casing Cover & Seal Chamber, Motor Stand (Lantern).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Vertical Inline Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Vertical Inline Pump.
Check seal leakage and motor bearing noise.
Grease motor bearings.
Lift motor and rotating assembly; inspect impeller and seal.
Watch for seal failure: leakage at the seal. Common cause: air trapped at the seal chamber (vertical shaft).
Watch for pipe strain: vibration. Common cause: unsupported piping.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.

questions.question: Why can air collect at the seal of a vertical inline pump?
options: The seal chamber is at the top of the casing
